criteria.detail: Closes on all 720 cells: the drift relative to the stock is at most 1e-09 on every one.
criteria.name: A41-1  the claim total the module tracks equals holdings plus parked at the end of every cell

criteria.detail: Holds on all 720 cells: no play above a cap; stops, abstentions, absences and plays add up to the cap on every node and round; no play from a node that had left when the round opened; no play from holdings below what the rule requires; no playing node below zero; no idle node moved; no more wins than plays; every settlement equals the stake times wins less losses to within 1e-09; every cell recorded rounds 50 to 299.
criteria.name: A41-2  the capital line, the caps and who is still in hold on every recorded attempt

criteria.detail: Holds: over 720 cells and 3 class pairs the three terms miss the gap by at most 1e-12 of it; plays per node times return per play misses the counted result per node by at most 1e-12; the counted result misses the ledger's by at most 1e-09; no pair-cell carries a price term, where every class faces one price and the term must be exactly zero
criteria.name: A41-3  the decomposition is an identity and ties to the ledger

criteria.detail: Holds: 120 of 720 cells played nothing, each is bitwise its control and flagged inert, and no cell that played is flagged. Inert cells by (p, stake, rule): [(0.51, 0.09, 'aware'), (0.51, 0.25, 'aware')]. They carry no reading.
criteria.name: A41-4  a cell that played nothing is bitwise its control, and only such cells are flagged inert
